# Data Quality Gate

> Preflight the entire original lead, order or inventory CSV/JSONL using explicitly approved constraints before CRM/database writes.

- [Offer](https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/quality): $20 plus applicable tax for 100 completed supported checks, five trials once per verified organization.
- [Capabilities](https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/quality/capabilities.json): actual bounds, supported rules and outcome semantics.
- [Integration](https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/quality/integrate): uploads, contract/baseline approval, quote, durable job, report, receipt, original download.
- [n8n recipes](https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/quality/workflows): configure and qualify before enabling a destination.
- [OpenAPI](https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/openapi.json): authenticated /v1/quality API.
- [Privacy](https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/quality/privacy): originals 24h, reports 7d, receipts 30d; approved decisions until deletion.

MCP: https://mcp.contentsweep.ai/v1/quality/mcp/; X-API-Key or Authorization Bearer organization key.
Only continue permits downstream writes by default. Warnings, blocks, errors and timeouts need review.
Use the actual uploaded bytes, not a supplied summary. The report is not the dataset.
Check the original download SHA256 against the receipt before passing data onward.
Completed block/warning is billable; unsupported/incomplete/platform failures and duplicate retries are free.
Quality credits are separate from supplier-feed credits. No quality subscription or automatic replenishment.
No data repair, transformation or independent verification of destination business meanings.
